verdict.rationale: Kong advertises plugins for 'logging, monitoring' and traffic control (kong-gh-3) and AI observability features (kong-gh-9, kong-gh-19), suggesting some support for metrics/logging/tracing integrations, but no evidence pack items explicitly confirm dedicated tracing (e.g., OpenTelemetry) or metrics integrations, and a community report shows real-world gaps where Kong's logging failed to surface issues during traffic anomalies (kong-comm-1, kong-comm-2), indicating partial and imperfect delivery.
